root_cause_or_implementation_gap: The existing edit dialog exposed only seven legacy fields, used the contact name as the only visible identity field, and did not pass optional summary, notes, priority or next-action values through the update payload. FRT-012 expands the mounted dialog, derives missing legacy values from the current record/history, adds truthful read-only controls where the schema has no writable field, and extends the existing PATCH owner for real persistence.

rules: Reference values are never copied into runtime state or submitted to the API.
Every editable visible control binds to the real Lead edit draft and existing update mutation.
Position, owner and last-contact channel are explicitly read-only or derived when the current backend has no writable field.
The existing delete confirmation, move-to-case flow, permission gate, loading state and detail refresh remain behavior owners.
No fake success, no-op action or second persistence model was introduced.
Styling is scoped to the mounted FRT-012 dialog in the canonical dialog/form owner.

visible_controls_wired: Existing values populate from the real normalized Lead and activity history; editable fields update the real draft; canonical status/source/priority/task options, required validation, date handling, save loading state, PATCH persistence, close/cancel reset, case handoff and delete confirmation are wired to existing owners.
